text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ugh... my skin still hasn't cleared up.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even though I had my skin analyzed and 
never skipped my skincare routine...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Kh, at this rate it'll become an unsolved 
mystery... ...Still, I can't give up.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Scaring everyone even further with such a 
disheveled appearance is S-I-M-P-L-Y 
U-N-A-C-C-E-P-T-A-B-L-E-!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Fenomeno investigated the 
mysterious skin breakout case, but failed 
to reach a solution...
